config.expected_if_false: In at least 2 of 3 seeds, layer-4 accel_step R2 is >= 0.55 or the normalised margin is >= 0.45. That would mean the ceiling depends on the dataset, and the data_seed 0 result does not generalise. Mixed outcomes, with only 1 seed outside the bounds or values between the bands, are reported as inconclusive.
config.expected_if_true: In all 3 seeds: layer-4 accel_step R2 is <= 0.50, the normalised margin is < 0.40, accel_step margin is >= required_margin, and R2 gains <= 0.03 between step 1000 and step 3000. The e<=0.9 ceiling would then not be a data_seed 0 artifact.
config.hypothesis: The e<=0.9 lower ceiling on linear accel_step decodability holds on a second dataset. Setup: data_seed 1, N=64, 4 layers, d_model=64, m2 in [0.1, 1], best-of-5 controls, seeds 70-72, 3000 steps, otherwise matching exp-20261016-014337-2921. Prediction: final raw layer-4 accel_step R2 stays at or below 0.50 in every seed, which is the data_seed 0 range (0.421-0.457) plus a 0.04 tolerance. The headroom-normalised accel_step margin stays below 0.40, and accel_step still beats its control. All values come from probes_final, unrounded. The layer-4 value is reported separately if layer 4 is not the best-margin layer. Growth is described as same-layer control plus margin between step 1000 and step 3000, and the prediction is that it is <= 0.03, i.e. a plateau.
